about.title: Personal Injury Help in Cotati, California
about.longDescription: Cotati is a small city, but its roads carry a lot of daily traffic — Old Redwood Highway, Route 116, E Cotati Avenue, and Highway 116 all see steady commuter and local flow. In the most recent full year on record, Sonoma County logged 23 injury collisions and 26 injured people connected to Cotati, with no traffic deaths reported. Behind every one of those numbers is a person dealing with medical bills, missed work, and a lot of uncertainty about what comes next. LawProactive is a free service that helps injured people in Cotati get connected with an independent personal injury attorney who can review their situation and explain their options. We are not a law firm, we don't provide legal advice, and we never charge you anything to make the connection. If an attorney in our network agrees to take your case, they work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. Our goal is simple: make it easier for people who've been hurt through no fault of their own to find the right help, without adding more stress to an already difficult time.

whyChoose.title: Why Cotati Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: You Have Time, But Not Forever
items.desc: California generally gives injured people two years from the date of an accident to file a personal injury claim. That window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity was involved, so it helps to understand your deadline early.

items.title: Shared Fault Doesn't Shut the Door
items.desc: California follows a pure comparative fault rule, meaning you can still recover compensation even if you were partly responsible for the accident. Your recovery is simply reduced by your share of fault, not eliminated.

items.title: No Ceiling on Pain and Suffering Claims
items.desc: Unlike some states, California places no cap on non-economic damages — like pain and suffering — in most ordinary injury cases. This matters when an injury affects your daily life in ways medical bills alone don't capture.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so you don't pay upfront and you owe nothing in attorney fees unless there's a settlement or award in your favor.

items.question: How much does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney in Sonoma County. There's no fee to get connected, and any attorney you work with typically operates on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, you have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit in California. If a government entity is involved, that deadline can be as short as six months, so it's wise to act sooner rather than later.

items.question: What if I was partly at fault for the accident?
items.answer: California uses a pure comparative fault system, so being partly at fault doesn't prevent you from recovering compensation. Your total recovery is adjusted based on your percentage of fault, but you're not automatically barred from a claim.
